title: CropAndLock: Add maximized-window reparent regression coverage

proposed_comments.title: Refresh child frame metrics after changing the style

confidence.rationale: The method measures the child client rectangle immediately after adding WS_CHILD but does not request a frame recalculation until after those measurements. The exact literal replacement builds.

proposed_comments.body:
### (1/2) Refresh child frame metrics after changing the style

**Severity:** `medium`

The next `GetWindowRect`/`GetClientRect` calls calculate the resized child frame immediately after `WS_CHILD` is added. Force Windows to recalculate the frame before measuring those dimensions; otherwise the non-client difference used to preserve the original client size is computed from stale top-level frame metrics. Apply both grouped geometry suggestions together.

```suggestion
    SetWindowLongPtrW(m_currentTarget, GWL_STYLE, targetStyle);
    winrt::check_bool(SetWindowPos(m_currentTarget, nullptr, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                                  SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_FRAMECHANGED | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE));
```

proposed_comments.title: Undo the client-origin offset before positioning the crop

confidence.rationale: The function already adds diffX/diffY to cropRect before deriving adjustedCropRect, then reuses those adjusted coordinates as the final child offset. The exact two-line replacement removes that duplicate offset and builds.

proposed_comments.body:
### (2/2) Undo the client-origin offset before positioning the crop

**Severity:** `medium`

Earlier in `CropAndLock`, the maximized-window path adds `diffX`/`diffY` to `cropRect` when converting the selected client-area coordinates. These final offsets use that already-adjusted rectangle directly, applying the origin shift a second time and displacing the cropped content. Subtract the conversion once when deriving the final child position. Apply both grouped geometry suggestions together.

```suggestion
    auto x = -(cropRect.left - diffX + (clientOrigin.x - finalWindowRect.left));
    auto y = -(cropRect.top - diffY + (clientOrigin.y - finalWindowRect.top));
```
